change: Publish complete rendering recipes atomically inside FITS before upload, preserving scientific HDUs and allowing replay without the Image JSON recipe copy.
proof: uint8 RGB, uint16 and float science pixels and unrelated HDUs survive plain/gzip publication.
Failed replace, oversized metadata, symlink and altered-science guards preserve the existing file.
Version-2 integrity hashes scientific HDUs independently of metadata to avoid a self-referential whole-file hash; historical version-1 recipes remain readable.
Upload callbacks observe the completed recipe and the correct final file size in the database and metadata.
Authenticated preview and generation reader reconstruct the same pixels from embedded context after removing the Image recipe JSON copy; preview does not alter the published file.
Historical image pipeline and FITS view fingerprints remain unchanged after normalization of reviewed metadata hooks.
deployment: Not deployed. Existing production FITS and capture configuration unchanged.
limits: Shared lossless rendering assets remain content-addressed in .render-assets on the archive volume; FITS recipe publication does not embed duplicate fonts and arrays per exposure.
Asset lifecycle, remaining source-aware web readers, configurable formats and external storage remain open.
Source-only activation must require successful recipe publication; on publication failure the existing processed-JPEG capture path is retained.
